podcast_a1_ep01_the_morning_.subtitle: Morning Cafe & Ordering
podcast_a1_ep01_the_morning_.description: Ordering a large oat milk latte and a warm croissant in a sunny morning cafe, asking for the price, paying with a contactless card, and asking for the Wi-Fi password.
podcast_a1_ep01_the_morning_.topicsCovered.1: Asking for the price (How much is...?)
podcast_a1_ep01_the_morning_.dialogue.0.textTr: Welcome to English Bites A1! Today, Emma is ordering breakfast at the Green Bean Cafe. Listen to how she orders politely and pays for her food.
podcast_a1_ep01_the_morning_.dialogue.1.textTr: Good morning! Welcome to Green Bean Cafe. What can I get for you today?
podcast_a1_ep01_the_morning_.dialogue.2.textTr: Good morning! Could I please have a large latte with oat milk?
podcast_a1_ep01_the_morning_.dialogue.4.textTr: Hot, please. And could you warm up one of those chocolate croissants?
podcast_a1_ep01_the_morning_.dialogue.5.textTr: Absolutely. Anything else for you today?
podcast_a1_ep01_the_morning_.dialogue.6.textTr: No, that is all. How much is the total?
podcast_a1_ep01_the_morning_.dialogue.7.textTr: That is six dollars and fifty cents. How would you like to pay?
podcast_a1_ep01_the_morning_.dialogue.8.textTr: By card, please. Here is my contactless card.
podcast_a1_ep01_the_morning_.dialogue.9.textTr: Perfect, it went through! Here is your receipt. Your drink will be ready at the counter in two minutes.
podcast_a1_ep01_the_morning_.dialogue.10.textTr: Thank you so much! By the way, what is the Wi-Fi password?
podcast_a1_ep01_the_morning_.dialogue.14.textTr: Great job! Notice how Emma used Could I please have... to order politely. Now practice saying: Could I have a coffee, please?

podcast_a1_ep02_morning_alar.subtitle: Morning Routines & Times
podcast_a1_ep02_morning_alar.description: Talking about what time you wake up, breakfast preferences (omelet, toast), commuting habits by bike/subway, and working hours.
podcast_a1_ep02_morning_alar.dialogue.0.textTr: Welcome back! In this episode, Sarah and David discuss their morning routines. Listen for daily action verbs and times!
podcast_a1_ep02_morning_alar.dialogue.1.textTr: Good morning, David! You look fresh today. What time do you usually wake up?
podcast_a1_ep02_morning_alar.dialogue.2.textTr: Good morning, Sarah! I always wake up at six thirty, but I get out of bed at seven o'clock. What about you?
podcast_a1_ep02_morning_alar.dialogue.3.textTr: I am a morning person! My alarm rings at six o'clock sharp. I always do ten minutes of yoga.
podcast_a1_ep02_morning_alar.dialogue.4.textTr: Wow, that is impressive! Do you eat breakfast at home?
podcast_a1_ep02_morning_alar.dialogue.5.textTr: Yes, I usually have an omelet and orange juice. What do you eat?
podcast_a1_ep02_morning_alar.dialogue.6.textTr: I only have black coffee and two slices of toast. I never have a heavy breakfast.
podcast_a1_ep02_morning_alar.dialogue.7.textTr: How do you commute to the office?
podcast_a1_ep02_morning_alar.dialogue.8.textTr: I take the subway. It takes twenty minutes. Do you ride your bike?
podcast_a1_ep02_morning_alar.dialogue.9.textTr: Yes, I ride my bike every day when the weather is nice. My workday starts at nine o'clock.
podcast_a1_ep02_morning_alar.dialogue.10.textTr: Mine starts at nine too. Let's start working!
podcast_a1_ep02_morning_alar.dialogue.11.textTr: Excellent! Remember: With 'he' and 'she', we say He wakes up and She rides her bike. What is your morning routine?

podcast_a1_ep03_lost_in_the_.subtitle: City Directions & Subway
podcast_a1_ep03_lost_in_the_.description: A person lost in the city center politely stops someone on the street to ask for the Central Metro Station, finding street directions and ticket machines.
podcast_a1_ep03_lost_in_the_.dialogue.0.textTr: Hello learners! In this episode, Alex is lost in the city center. Listen to how Mia gives clear directions to the metro station.
podcast_a1_ep03_lost_in_the_.dialogue.1.textTr: Excuse me! Could you help me, please? I am lost.
podcast_a1_ep03_lost_in_the_.dialogue.2.textTr: Sure! Where do you want to go?
podcast_a1_ep03_lost_in_the_.dialogue.3.textTr: Where is the Central Metro Station? Is it far from here?
podcast_a1_ep03_lost_in_the_.dialogue.4.textTr: No, it is very close. It is about a five-minute walk.
podcast_a1_ep03_lost_in_the_.dialogue.5.textTr: Great! How do I get there?
podcast_a1_ep03_lost_in_the_.dialogue.6.textTr: Walk straight down this street for two blocks. Then, turn left at the big bank.
podcast_a1_ep03_lost_in_the_.dialogue.7.textTr: Turn left at the bank, okay. And after that?
podcast_a1_ep03_lost_in_the_.dialogue.8.textTr: Walk straight ahead. You will see a large city park on your right. The metro station is opposite the park, next to the library.
podcast_a1_ep03_lost_in_the_.dialogue.9.textTr: Opposite the park, next to the library. Is there a ticket machine inside?
podcast_a1_ep03_lost_in_the_.dialogue.10.textTr: Yes, there are three ticket machines right at the entrance.
podcast_a1_ep03_lost_in_the_.dialogue.11.textTr: Thank you very much for your help!
podcast_a1_ep03_lost_in_the_.dialogue.12.textTr: You are very welcome! Have a nice trip!
podcast_a1_ep03_lost_in_the_.dialogue.13.textTr: Notice the useful phrases: Walk straight down, Turn left, and Opposite the park. Try asking for directions today!

podcast_a1_ep04_dinner_at_th.subtitle: Dinner Order at the Bistro
podcast_a1_ep04_dinner_at_th.description: Requesting a table at a restaurant, ordering an appetizer (tomato bruschetta), main course (grilled chicken and salad), and asking for the bill.
podcast_a1_ep04_dinner_at_th.dialogue.0.textTr: Welcome to Episode 4! Chloe is dining at Bella Vista Bistro. Listen to how she orders food and asks for the bill politely.
podcast_a1_ep04_dinner_at_th.dialogue.1.textTr: Good evening! Welcome to Bella Vista Bistro. Do you have a reservation?
podcast_a1_ep04_dinner_at_th.dialogue.2.textTr: Good evening! No, we don't. Do you have a table for two?
podcast_a1_ep04_dinner_at_th.dialogue.3.textTr: Yes, right this way. Here are your menus. Can I bring you something to drink first?
podcast_a1_ep04_dinner_at_th.dialogue.4.textTr: Could we have a bottle of sparkling water with lemon, please?
podcast_a1_ep04_dinner_at_th.dialogue.5.textTr: Of course. Are you ready to order food?
podcast_a1_ep04_dinner_at_th.dialogue.6.textTr: Yes! For our starter, we would like the tomato bruschetta.
podcast_a1_ep04_dinner_at_th.dialogue.7.textTr: Delicious choice. And for your main course?
podcast_a1_ep04_dinner_at_th.dialogue.8.textTr: I would like the grilled chicken with pasta, and my friend would like the vegetarian pizza.
podcast_a1_ep04_dinner_at_th.dialogue.9.textTr: Excellent. I will place your order right away.
podcast_a1_ep04_dinner_at_th.dialogue.10.textTr: Excuse me, sir! Everything was delicious. Could we please have the bill?
podcast_a1_ep04_dinner_at_th.dialogue.11.textTr: Certainly! Here is your bill. Thank you for dining with us!
podcast_a1_ep04_dinner_at_th.dialogue.12.textTr: Notice the classic phrase: I would like the grilled chicken, please. Use I would like... whenever you order food!

podcast_a1_ep05_weekend_memo.subtitle: What did you do yesterday & Weekend plan
podcast_a1_ep05_weekend_memo.description: Describe walking in the park yesterday afternoon, watching a movie at home last night, and planning a picnic in the city park on Saturday.
podcast_a1_ep05_weekend_memo.dialogue.0.textTr: Hi everyone! In this episode, Leo and Sophie talk about what they did yesterday and plan a weekend picnic. Listen for past tense verbs!
podcast_a1_ep05_weekend_memo.dialogue.1.textTr: Hi Sophie! How was your day yesterday?
podcast_a1_ep05_weekend_memo.dialogue.2.textTr: It was great, Leo! The weather was sunny, so I walked in the city park and took many photos.
podcast_a1_ep05_weekend_memo.dialogue.3.textTr: That sounds relaxing! Did you cook dinner at home last night?
podcast_a1_ep05_weekend_memo.dialogue.4.textTr: Yes, I cooked vegetable soup and watched a nice movie. What did you do?
podcast_a1_ep05_weekend_memo.dialogue.5.textTr: I stayed at home and read a book about nature. Are you free this Saturday?
podcast_a1_ep05_weekend_memo.dialogue.6.textTr: Yes, I am! The weather forecast says it will be warm.
podcast_a1_ep05_weekend_memo.dialogue.7.textTr: Wonderful! Let's have a picnic in the park. I can bring sandwiches and apples.
podcast_a1_ep05_weekend_memo.dialogue.8.textTr: Great idea! I can bring orange juice and a picnic blanket.
podcast_a1_ep05_weekend_memo.dialogue.10.textTr: Let's meet at twelve o'clock near the park entrance.
podcast_a1_ep05_weekend_memo.dialogue.11.textTr: Perfect! See you on Saturday, Sophie!
podcast_a1_ep05_weekend_memo.dialogue.12.textTr: Did you catch the past regular verbs? Walked, cooked, and watched. Practice talking about your yesterday!

podcast_a1_ep06_meeting_a_ne.subtitle: Meeting a New Colleague
podcast_a1_ep06_meeting_a_ne.description: Meeting a new colleague on your first day at the office, asking where they are from, describing your job, and showing the coffee area.
podcast_a1_ep06_meeting_a_ne.topicsCovered.1: Asking about Country/Nationality (Where are you from?)
podcast_a1_ep06_meeting_a_ne.dialogue.0.textTr: Welcome to Episode 6! Oğuzhan is meeting Emily, a new UI designer on the team. Listen to simple introductions!  Oğuzhan: Hello! Welcome to the team! My name is Oğuzhan.
podcast_a1_ep06_meeting_a_ne.dialogue.1.textTr: Hi Oğuzhan! Nice to meet you. I am Emily. Oğuzhan: Nice to meet you too, Emily! Is this your first day at the company?
podcast_a1_ep06_meeting_a_ne.dialogue.2.textTr: Yes, it is! I am the new mobile app designer. Oğuzhan: That is great! I am a full-stack developer on the same project. Where are you from?
podcast_a1_ep06_meeting_a_ne.dialogue.3.textTr: I am from Canada, but I live here now. Are you from Turkey? Oğuzhan: Yes, I am from Turkey. Let me show you around. This is our main work room, and that is the coffee kitchen.
podcast_a1_ep06_meeting_a_ne.dialogue.4.textTr: Thank you so much! I love coffee. Oğuzhan: You can sit at this desk next to the window. If you need any help, just ask me!
podcast_a1_ep06_meeting_a_ne.dialogue.5.textTr: That is very kind of you. Let's make a great app together!
podcast_a1_ep06_meeting_a_ne.dialogue.6.textTr: Short and friendly! Nice to meet you is the best way to greet someone new. Practice introducing yourself today!

podcast_a1_ep07_grocery_shop.subtitle: Supermarket & Prices
podcast_a1_ep07_grocery_shop.description: Dialogue for asking about fruits, vegetables, and cheese in the supermarket, asking for quantity, learning prices, and requesting a bag.
podcast_a1_ep07_grocery_shop.dialogue.0.textTr: In Episode 7, Ben is shopping for groceries at the local supermarket. Listen to how he asks for locations and prices.
podcast_a1_ep07_grocery_shop.dialogue.1.textTr: Excuse me, where can I find fresh eggs and milk?
podcast_a1_ep07_grocery_shop.dialogue.2.textTr: Hello! They are in aisle 3, right next to the cheese section.
podcast_a1_ep07_grocery_shop.dialogue.3.textTr: Thank you. Are there any organic red apples today?
podcast_a1_ep07_grocery_shop.dialogue.4.textTr: Yes, there are some organic apples in the fruit section at the front.
podcast_a1_ep07_grocery_shop.dialogue.5.textTr: Great! How much are the apples per kilogram?
podcast_a1_ep07_grocery_shop.dialogue.6.textTr: They are three dollars a kilo.
podcast_a1_ep07_grocery_shop.dialogue.7.textTr: Perfect, I will take one kilo of apples, a carton of milk, and some eggs.
podcast_a1_ep07_grocery_shop.dialogue.8.textTr: Hello! Do you need a shopping bag today?
podcast_a1_ep07_grocery_shop.dialogue.10.textTr: Your total is nine dollars and twenty cents. Cash or card?
podcast_a1_ep07_grocery_shop.dialogue.11.textTr: Cash, please. Here is a ten-dollar bill.
podcast_a1_ep07_grocery_shop.dialogue.12.textTr: And here is your change, eighty cents. Have a nice evening!
podcast_a1_ep07_grocery_shop.dialogue.14.textTr: Key questions to remember: Where can I find...? and How much are the apples? Very useful for everyday shopping!

podcast_a1_ep08_my_family_ho.subtitle: My Family and Hobbies
podcast_a1_ep08_my_family_ho.description: Talking about family members (mother, father, sibling), professions, hobbies done in free time (playing football, playing guitar, painting).
podcast_a1_ep08_my_family_ho.dialogue.0.textTr: Welcome to Episode 8! Tom and Anna are looking at photos and talking about their families and hobbies.
podcast_a1_ep08_my_family_ho.dialogue.1.textTr: Is this photo your family, Tom?
podcast_a1_ep08_my_family_ho.dialogue.2.textTr: Yes, it is! This is my father and this is my mother.
podcast_a1_ep08_my_family_ho.dialogue.4.textTr: My father is an engineer, and my mother is a high school teacher.
podcast_a1_ep08_my_family_ho.dialogue.5.textTr: That is wonderful! Do you have any brothers or sisters?
podcast_a1_ep08_my_family_ho.dialogue.6.textTr: Yes, I have an older brother. His name is Sam. He works with 3D printers and computers.
podcast_a1_ep08_my_family_ho.dialogue.7.textTr: What do you like to do in your free time together?
podcast_a1_ep08_my_family_ho.dialogue.8.textTr: Sam likes playing football on weekends, but I prefer music. I play the acoustic guitar.
podcast_a1_ep08_my_family_ho.dialogue.9.textTr: Really? I love music too! I play the piano and I like drawing digital art.
podcast_a1_ep08_my_family_ho.dialogue.10.textTr: That is cool! We should play music together sometime.
podcast_a1_ep08_my_family_ho.dialogue.12.textTr: Remember: We say He works, She likes, and His name is. How would you describe your family in English?

podcast_a1_ep09_at_the_pharm.subtitle: Requesting Simple Medicine at the Pharmacy
podcast_a1_ep09_at_the_pharm.description: Going to the pharmacy for a mild headache and cold, simply explaining the complaint, getting painkillers and vitamins.
podcast_a1_ep09_at_the_pharm.topicsCovered.0: Simple health sentences (I have a headache / cold)
podcast_a1_ep09_at_the_pharm.topicsCovered.2: Medication instructions (take one tablet after meals).
podcast_a1_ep09_at_the_pharm.dialogue.0.textTr: In Episode 9, James is not feeling well and visits a pharmacy. Listen to simple health phrases and medicine instructions.
podcast_a1_ep09_at_the_pharm.dialogue.1.textTr: Hello! How can I help you today?
podcast_a1_ep09_at_the_pharm.dialogue.2.textTr: Hello. I am not feeling very well. I have a bad headache and a sore throat.
podcast_a1_ep09_at_the_pharm.dialogue.3.textTr: I see. Do you have a fever or a cough?
podcast_a1_ep09_at_the_pharm.dialogue.4.textTr: No, no fever. Just a headache and a mild cold.
podcast_a1_ep09_at_the_pharm.dialogue.5.textTr: Okay. I can give you these painkiller tablets and some vitamin C.
podcast_a1_ep09_at_the_pharm.dialogue.6.textTr: How should I take this medicine?
podcast_a1_ep09_at_the_pharm.dialogue.7.textTr: Take one tablet with water two times a day, always after meals.
podcast_a1_ep09_at_the_pharm.dialogue.8.textTr: Two times a day, after meals. Got it. Do I need a doctor's prescription for this?
podcast_a1_ep09_at_the_pharm.dialogue.9.textTr: No, this is an over-the-counter medicine. You don't need a prescription.
podcast_a1_ep09_at_the_pharm.dialogue.11.textTr: It is eight dollars in total. Drink plenty of warm water and rest well.
podcast_a1_ep09_at_the_pharm.dialogue.12.textTr: Thank you so much for your advice.
podcast_a1_ep09_at_the_pharm.dialogue.13.textTr: Useful phrases when you are sick: I have a headache, I have a cold, and Take after meals. Stay healthy!

podcast_a1_ep10_a_simple_pho.subtitle: Short Phone Call & Appointment
podcast_a1_ep10_a_simple_pho.description: Call the dental clinic to request an appointment, choose a day and time, spell your name and phone number.
podcast_a1_ep10_a_simple_pho.topicsCovered.2: Days and times (on Thursday at 3 PM).
podcast_a1_ep10_a_simple_pho.dialogue.0.textTr: Welcome to Episode 10! Lisa is calling a dental clinic to book a routine check-up. Listen to telephone English basics.
podcast_a1_ep10_a_simple_pho.dialogue.1.textTr: Good morning! Smile Dental Clinic. How may I help you?
podcast_a1_ep10_a_simple_pho.dialogue.2.textTr: Hello! This is Lisa Miller calling. I would like to make an appointment for a routine dental check-up.
podcast_a1_ep10_a_simple_pho.dialogue.3.textTr: Certainly, Ms. Miller. Are you a new patient?
podcast_a1_ep10_a_simple_pho.dialogue.4.textTr: Yes, this is my first time.
podcast_a1_ep10_a_simple_pho.dialogue.5.textTr: Welcome! Is Thursday afternoon good for you? Dr. Smith is available at three o'clock.
podcast_a1_ep10_a_simple_pho.dialogue.6.textTr: Thursday at three o'clock is perfect.
podcast_a1_ep10_a_simple_pho.dialogue.7.textTr: Could you please spell your last name for me?
podcast_a1_ep10_a_simple_pho.dialogue.9.textTr: Thank you. And what is your phone number?
podcast_a1_ep10_a_simple_pho.dialogue.11.textTr: Great. We have booked your appointment for Thursday at 3 PM. Please arrive ten minutes early.
podcast_a1_ep10_a_simple_pho.dialogue.12.textTr: Thank you very much. Have a nice day!
podcast_a1_ep10_a_simple_pho.dialogue.14.textTr: Congratulations on completing the A1 series! Practice spelling your name and saying your phone number in English!

podcast_a2_ep01_boarding_pas.subtitle: Airport Check-in & Flight Gate
podcast_a2_ep01_boarding_pas.description: Check in for the London flight, weigh luggage (21 kg), hand luggage rules, select window seat (14A), and proceed to security check.
podcast_a2_ep01_boarding_pas.topicsCovered.1: Permission/Request forms (Would it be possible to...)?
podcast_a2_ep01_boarding_pas.dialogue.0.textTr: Welcome to A2 Episode 1! Rachel is checking in for her international flight to London. Listen to airport vocabulary and polite requests.
podcast_a2_ep01_boarding_pas.dialogue.1.textTr: Good afternoon! Welcome to SkyWay Airlines. May I see your passport, please?
podcast_a2_ep01_boarding_pas.dialogue.2.textTr: Good afternoon! Here is my passport and booking confirmation.
podcast_a2_ep01_boarding_pas.dialogue.3.textTr: Thank you, Ms. Green. Are you checking any luggage today?
podcast_a2_ep01_boarding_pas.dialogue.5.textTr: Please place it on the scale. ... Perfect, it is 21 kilograms, which is within your 23-kilogram baggage allowance.
podcast_a2_ep01_boarding_pas.dialogue.6.textTr: Excellent. I also have this small backpack as my carry-on bag.
podcast_a2_ep01_boarding_pas.dialogue.7.textTr: That is totally fine. Would you prefer a window seat or an aisle seat today?
podcast_a2_ep01_boarding_pas.dialogue.8.textTr: Would it be possible to get a window seat near the front of the aircraft?
podcast_a2_ep01_boarding_pas.dialogue.9.textTr: Let me check... Yes! I have seat 14A available for you. Here is your boarding pass.
podcast_a2_ep01_boarding_pas.dialogue.10.textTr: Thank you! What gate is the flight departing from?
podcast_a2_ep01_boarding_pas.dialogue.11.textTr: Your flight will depart from Gate 24. Boarding starts at 3:30 PM. Proceed through security checkpoint B on your right.
podcast_a2_ep01_boarding_pas.dialogue.12.textTr: Wonderful! Thank you for your assistance.
podcast_a2_ep01_boarding_pas.dialogue.14.textTr: Notice how Rachel asked: Would it be possible to get a window seat? A great polite structure for A2 learners!

podcast_a2_ep02_hotel_check_.subtitle: Hotel Check-in & Room Requests
podcast_a2_ep02_hotel_check_.description: Check in for a 3-night Deluxe King room, learn breakfast times, Wi-Fi connection, and request 2 extra pillows for the room.
podcast_a2_ep02_hotel_check_.topicsCovered.0: Indirect question asking (Could you please tell me what time...)
podcast_a2_ep02_hotel_check_.dialogue.0.textTr: In Episode 2, Clara arrives at the Grand Harbor Hotel. Listen to how she checks in and asks about amenities.
podcast_a2_ep02_hotel_check_.dialogue.1.textTr: Good evening! Welcome to the Grand Harbor Hotel. How may I assist you?
podcast_a2_ep02_hotel_check_.dialogue.2.textTr: Good evening! I have a reservation under the name Clara Bennett for three nights.
podcast_a2_ep02_hotel_check_.dialogue.3.textTr: Welcome, Ms. Bennett. Yes, I see your booking for a Deluxe King room with a harbor view. May I have your ID and a credit card for the room deposit?
podcast_a2_ep02_hotel_check_.dialogue.4.textTr: Here is my passport and my card.
podcast_a2_ep02_hotel_check_.dialogue.5.textTr: Thank you. You are on the 7th floor in room 712. Here are your two electronic key cards.
podcast_a2_ep02_hotel_check_.dialogue.6.textTr: Could you please tell me what time breakfast is served in the morning?
podcast_a2_ep02_hotel_check_.dialogue.7.textTr: Our complimentary buffet breakfast is served on the second floor from 7:00 AM to 10:30 AM every morning.
podcast_a2_ep02_hotel_check_.dialogue.8.textTr: That is great. Also, could housekeeping bring two extra pillows to my room tonight?
podcast_a2_ep02_hotel_check_.dialogue.9.textTr: Certainly, I will inform housekeeping immediately. The elevators are right behind you on the left.
podcast_a2_ep02_hotel_check_.dialogue.10.textTr: Thank you very much for your help, James.
podcast_a2_ep02_hotel_check_.dialogue.11.textTr: It is my pleasure. Enjoy your stay with us!
podcast_a2_ep02_hotel_check_.dialogue.12.textTr: Great listening! Practice asking: Could you please tell me what time breakfast is served?

podcast_a2_ep03_shopping_spr.subtitle: Clothing Shopping & Returns in Store
podcast_a2_ep03_shopping_spr.description: Searching for the medium size navy wool sweater, trying it on in the fitting room, taking advantage of the 20% discount, and learning about the 30-day return policy.
podcast_a2_ep03_shopping_spr.topicsCovered.1: Do you have this in medium?)
podcast_a2_ep03_shopping_spr.dialogue.0.textTr: Welcome to Episode 3! Nora is shopping for a winter sweater. Listen to shopping vocabulary, sizes, and discount expressions!
podcast_a2_ep03_shopping_spr.dialogue.1.textTr: Hi there! Are you looking for anything specific today?
podcast_a2_ep03_shopping_spr.dialogue.2.textTr: Hello! Yes, I really like this navy blue wool sweater on display, but I can only find it in size small. Do you have it in a medium?
podcast_a2_ep03_shopping_spr.dialogue.3.textTr: Let me check our stock database... Yes, we have two medium sweaters left in our back storage. I will bring one for you right now.
podcast_a2_ep03_shopping_spr.dialogue.4.textTr: Thank you so much! Where are the fitting rooms located?
podcast_a2_ep03_shopping_spr.dialogue.5.textTr: The fitting rooms are straight ahead, right next to the mirrors.
podcast_a2_ep03_shopping_spr.dialogue.7.textTr: It fits perfectly! Is this item on sale?
podcast_a2_ep03_shopping_spr.dialogue.8.textTr: Yes, all knitwear is twenty percent off this weekend. The original price is sixty dollars, so the discounted total is forty-eight dollars.
podcast_a2_ep03_shopping_spr.dialogue.9.textTr: Wonderful! What is your return policy just in case?
podcast_a2_ep03_shopping_spr.dialogue.10.textTr: You can return or exchange any unworn item within thirty days with your original store receipt.
podcast_a2_ep03_shopping_spr.dialogue.12.textTr: Notice: Do you have this in a medium? and What is your return policy? Excellent phrases for your next shopping trip!

podcast_a2_ep04_a_doctor_s_v.subtitle: Doctor's Exam & Advice
podcast_a2_ep04_a_doctor_s_v.description: Describe sore throat, dry cough, and fever lasting for 3 days, get examined, receive viral diagnosis, and advice.
podcast_a2_ep04_a_doctor_s_v.topicsCovered.0: Reporting illness (I have a sore throat)
podcast_a2_ep04_a_doctor_s_v.dialogue.0.textTr: In Episode 4, Lily visits Dr. Harrison because she feels sick. Listen to how she describes her symptoms and how the doctor gives medical advice.
podcast_a2_ep04_a_doctor_s_v.dialogue.1.textTr: Good morning, Lily. What seems to be the problem today?
podcast_a2_ep04_a_doctor_s_v.dialogue.2.textTr: Good morning, doctor. I have had a severe sore throat and a dry cough for the past three days.
podcast_a2_ep04_a_doctor_s_v.dialogue.3.textTr: I see. Have you measured your body temperature?
podcast_a2_ep04_a_doctor_s_v.dialogue.4.textTr: Yes, I had a mild fever of 38 degrees yesterday evening, and I feel very exhausted.
podcast_a2_ep04_a_doctor_s_v.dialogue.5.textTr: Let me examine your throat and listen to your breathing. Open wide and say 'Ah'. ... Your throat is inflamed, but your lungs sound clear. It appears to be a common viral upper respiratory infection.
podcast_a2_ep04_a_doctor_s_v.dialogue.6.textTr: Do I need to take antibiotics?
podcast_a2_ep04_a_doctor_s_v.dialogue.7.textTr: No, antibiotics are not effective against viruses. You should drink plenty of warm herbal tea, get at least eight hours of sleep, and avoid cold beverages.
podcast_a2_ep04_a_doctor_s_v.dialogue.8.textTr: Should I take any medicine for the pain?
podcast_a2_ep04_a_doctor_s_v.dialogue.9.textTr: I will write you a prescription for a soothing throat spray and a mild painkiller. Take the painkiller twice a day after meals. You should recover fully within five days.
podcast_a2_ep04_a_doctor_s_v.dialogue.10.textTr: Thank you very much, Dr. Harrison!
podcast_a2_ep04_a_doctor_s_v.dialogue.11.textTr: Notice the modal verb 'should' for advice: You should drink warm tea and You shouldn't drink cold beverages.

podcast_a2_ep05_cinema_night.subtitle: Cinema Session & Movie Preferences
podcast_a2_ep05_cinema_night.description: Making plans to go to the new sci-fi adventure movie, evaluating the trailer and visual effects, buying tickets online, and setting a meeting time.
podcast_a2_ep05_cinema_night.dialogue.0.textTr: Welcome to Episode 5! Mark and Zoe are planning a weekend movie night. Listen to how they compare films and choose screening times.
podcast_a2_ep05_cinema_night.dialogue.1.textTr: Hey Zoe! Have you seen the trailer for the new sci-fi adventure movie, 'Galaxy Wanderers'?
podcast_a2_ep05_cinema_night.dialogue.2.textTr: Yes, I watched it yesterday! The visual effects look like the most breathtaking in cinema history.
podcast_a2_ep05_cinema_night.dialogue.3.textTr: Absolutely! Critics say it is the best sci-fi film of the year. Shall we go see it this Saturday evening?
podcast_a2_ep05_cinema_night.dialogue.4.textTr: I would love to! Which cinema should we choose?
podcast_a2_ep05_cinema_night.dialogue.5.textTr: The downtown IMAX theater has the largest screen and the most comfortable VIP seats.
podcast_a2_ep05_cinema_night.dialogue.6.textTr: Great choice. There is a screening at 7:15 PM and another one at 9:45 PM. Which one do you prefer?
podcast_a2_ep05_cinema_night.dialogue.7.textTr: The 7:15 PM session is better because we can have dinner afterwards.
podcast_a2_ep05_cinema_night.dialogue.8.textTr: Perfect. I will book two tickets online right now so we get the best seats in the middle.
podcast_a2_ep05_cinema_night.dialogue.9.textTr: Awesome! Why don't we meet at 6:45 PM at the popcorn stand near the entrance?
podcast_a2_ep05_cinema_night.dialogue.10.textTr: Sounds like a plan. See you on Saturday!
podcast_a2_ep05_cinema_night.dialogue.11.textTr: Look at the superlative structures: the most breathtaking and the largest screen. Practice comparing things you like!

podcast_a2_ep06_renting_a_ca.subtitle: Car Rental for Travel
podcast_a2_ep06_renting_a_ca.description: Renting an economical or SUV vehicle for a weekend trip, fuel policy, full coverage insurance, and driver's license check.
podcast_a2_ep06_renting_a_ca.topicsCovered.2: Obligation mood (You have to return with full tank).
podcast_a2_ep06_renting_a_ca.dialogue.0.textTr: In Episode 6, Liam is renting a car for a weekend mountain trip. Listen to car rental vocabulary and comparison structures!
podcast_a2_ep06_renting_a_ca.dialogue.1.textTr: Good morning! Welcome to Express Car Rentals. How can I help you today?
podcast_a2_ep06_renting_a_ca.dialogue.2.textTr: Hello! I would like to rent a car for a three-day weekend trip to the mountains.
podcast_a2_ep06_renting_a_ca.dialogue.3.textTr: Great! We have compact economy cars and mid-size SUVs available. How many people are traveling?
podcast_a2_ep06_renting_a_ca.dialogue.4.textTr: Four adults with large luggage bags.
podcast_a2_ep06_renting_a_ca.dialogue.5.textTr: In that case, the SUV is much more spacious and comfortable than the compact car. It also has all-wheel drive, which is safer for mountain roads.
podcast_a2_ep06_renting_a_ca.dialogue.6.textTr: How much is the SUV per day?
podcast_a2_ep06_renting_a_ca.dialogue.7.textTr: It is fifty-five dollars per day, including unlimited mileage. The compact car is cheaper at thirty-five dollars, but it is too small for four suitcases.
podcast_a2_ep06_renting_a_ca.dialogue.8.textTr: I agree. Let's go with the SUV. Does it include full insurance coverage?
podcast_a2_ep06_renting_a_ca.dialogue.9.textTr: Basic insurance is included, but you can add comprehensive insurance for ten dollars extra per day.
podcast_a2_ep06_renting_a_ca.dialogue.10.textTr: I will take the full insurance for peace of mind.
podcast_a2_ep06_renting_a_ca.dialogue.11.textTr: Excellent. Please show me your driver's license and credit card. Remember, you have to return the vehicle with a full tank of fuel.
podcast_a2_ep06_renting_a_ca.dialogue.13.textTr: Key comparative phrase: The SUV is more spacious than the compact car. Practice renting a vehicle in English!

podcast_a2_ep07_tech_support.subtitle: Customer Service & Device Malfunction
podcast_a2_ep07_tech_support.description: Smartphone freezing during system update, restart steps, warranty coverage, and data backup check.
podcast_a2_ep07_tech_support.topicsCovered.0: Past Continuous with when/while (It froze while I was updating)
podcast_a2_ep07_tech_support.dialogue.0.textTr: Welcome to Episode 7! David is calling technical customer support because his smartphone stopped working. Listen to tech troubleshooting phrases!
podcast_a2_ep07_tech_support.dialogue.1.textTr: Thank you for calling TechCare Support. My name is Alex. How can I assist you today?
podcast_a2_ep07_tech_support.dialogue.2.textTr: Hi Alex. My smartphone froze while I was installing the latest operating system update this morning.
podcast_a2_ep07_tech_support.dialogue.3.textTr: I am sorry to hear that. What is currently showing on your screen?
podcast_a2_ep07_tech_support.dialogue.4.textTr: The screen is completely black, and the power button is not responding.
podcast_a2_ep07_tech_support.dialogue.5.textTr: Let's try a hard restart together. Please press and hold both the power button and the volume down button simultaneously for ten seconds.
podcast_a2_ep07_tech_support.dialogue.6.textTr: Okay, I am holding them now... Ah! The company logo just appeared on the screen!
podcast_a2_ep07_tech_support.dialogue.7.textTr: Excellent, the device is rebooting into recovery mode. Did you back up your photos and files before updating?
podcast_a2_ep07_tech_support.dialogue.8.textTr: Yes, I backed up everything to my cloud account yesterday.
podcast_a2_ep07_tech_support.dialogue.9.textTr: Perfect! Now select 'continue normal boot' on the menu. The update will complete safely in three minutes.
podcast_a2_ep07_tech_support.dialogue.10.textTr: It is working now! Thank you so much for your quick help, Alex.
podcast_a2_ep07_tech_support.dialogue.11.textTr: You are very welcome! Have a wonderful day.
podcast_a2_ep07_tech_support.dialogue.12.textTr: Did you hear the past continuous: My phone froze while I was installing the update? Very natural for tech support calls!

podcast_a2_ep08_inviting_a_f.subtitle: Dinner Invitation & Recipe
podcast_a2_ep08_inviting_a_f.description: Inviting your friend to homemade Italian pasta on Friday night, asking about allergies and dietary restrictions, offering to bring dessert.
podcast_a2_ep08_inviting_a_f.topicsCovered.2: Invitation phrases (Would you like to come over...)
podcast_a2_ep08_inviting_a_f.dialogue.0.textTr: In Episode 8, Maya calls Ethan to invite him to a homemade dinner. Listen to conversational invitations and food quantifiers!
podcast_a2_ep08_inviting_a_f.dialogue.1.textTr: Hey Ethan! Do you have any plans for this Friday evening?
podcast_a2_ep08_inviting_a_f.dialogue.2.textTr: Hi Maya! No, I am completely free. Why do you ask?
podcast_a2_ep08_inviting_a_f.dialogue.3.textTr: Would you like to come over to my place for dinner? I am cooking homemade pasta with fresh basil and tomato sauce.
podcast_a2_ep08_inviting_a_f.dialogue.4.textTr: That sounds amazing! I would love to come. Do you need me to bring any ingredients?
podcast_a2_ep08_inviting_a_f.dialogue.5.textTr: I already have a few fresh tomatoes and olive oil, but we only have a little parmesan cheese left. Could you bring some cheese?
podcast_a2_ep08_inviting_a_f.dialogue.6.textTr: Sure thing! I can pick up some authentic parmesan on my way from work. By the way, are you making dessert?
podcast_a2_ep08_inviting_a_f.dialogue.8.textTr: Let me bring a box of fresh chocolate pastries from the local bakery then!
podcast_a2_ep08_inviting_a_f.dialogue.9.textTr: That would be fantastic! What time will you arrive?
podcast_a2_ep08_inviting_a_f.dialogue.10.textTr: I can be at your apartment around seven o'clock.
podcast_a2_ep08_inviting_a_f.dialogue.11.textTr: Perfect! See you on Friday at seven!
podcast_a2_ep08_inviting_a_f.dialogue.12.textTr: Notice the quantifier usage: a few fresh tomatoes (countable) and a little parmesan cheese (uncountable). Great job!

podcast_a2_ep09_planning_a_s.subtitle: Summer Vacation Plan & Comparison
podcast_a2_ep09_planning_a_s.description: Comparing a beach holiday on the Mediterranean coast with a nature tour in Scandinavia, budgeting, hotel vs. rental apartment choice, and buying tickets.
podcast_a2_ep09_planning_a_s.dialogue.0.textTr: Welcome to Episode 9! Chloe and Sam are comparing vacation destinations for the summer. Listen for travel vocabulary and comparative adjectives!
podcast_a2_ep09_planning_a_s.dialogue.1.textTr: Sam, we really need to book our summer vacation this week before flight prices go up!
podcast_a2_ep09_planning_a_s.dialogue.2.textTr: You are right. Are we going to visit the Mediterranean coast in Greece or travel to Norway?
podcast_a2_ep09_planning_a_s.dialogue.3.textTr: Greece is much warmer and cheaper than Norway. A seaside beach vacation is also more relaxing for me after a busy work year.
podcast_a2_ep09_planning_a_s.dialogue.4.textTr: That's true, but Norway has the most breathtaking mountain fjords in Europe.
podcast_a2_ep09_planning_a_s.dialogue.5.textTr: If we choose Greece, our total accommodation and flight budget will be forty percent lower.
podcast_a2_ep09_planning_a_s.dialogue.6.textTr: That is a significant financial difference. Which Greek island is the most affordable?
podcast_a2_ep09_planning_a_s.dialogue.7.textTr: Crete is larger and less expensive than Santorini. We can rent a lovely seaside apartment near the beach.
podcast_a2_ep09_planning_a_s.dialogue.8.textTr: That sounds perfect. If we book the flight tickets today, we will get a special early-bird discount.
podcast_a2_ep09_planning_a_s.dialogue.9.textTr: Let's open the booking website right now and confirm the dates for the second week of July!
podcast_a2_ep09_planning_a_s.dialogue.10.textTr: Excellent, I am really looking forward to this trip!
podcast_a2_ep09_planning_a_s.dialogue.11.textTr: Notice the First Conditional: If we book today, we will get a discount. Great grammar integration for A2!

podcast_a2_ep10_a_job_fair_b.subtitle: Key Skills at the Career Fair
podcast_a2_ep10_a_job_fair_b.description: Visiting a tech company booth at the university career fair, asking about internship opportunities, describing programming skills and projects.
podcast_a2_ep10_a_job_fair_b.topicsCovered.0: Experience with Present Perfect (Have you built any apps?)
podcast_a2_ep10_a_job_fair_b.topicsCovered.1: Modals of ability (I can code in Python and Kotlin)
podcast_a2_ep10_a_job_fair_b.dialogue.0.textTr: In our final A2 episode, Kevin visits a tech company booth at a university career fair. Listen to professional introductory conversations!
podcast_a2_ep10_a_job_fair_b.dialogue.1.textTr: Hello! Welcome to the NovaTech booth. Are you interested in our software engineering summer internship program?
podcast_a2_ep10_a_job_fair_b.dialogue.2.textTr: Hello! Yes, very much. I am a junior computer engineering student, and I am looking for a full-stack developer internship.
podcast_a2_ep10_a_job_fair_b.dialogue.3.textTr: Wonderful! Have you worked on any mobile or web projects so far?
podcast_a2_ep10_a_job_fair_b.dialogue.4.textTr: Yes, I have! I have built two Android applications using Kotlin and Jetpack Compose, and I have also developed a full-stack web project using React and Node.js.
podcast_a2_ep10_a_job_fair_b.dialogue.5.textTr: That is an impressive portfolio for a student. Can you work comfortably in a team environment?
podcast_a2_ep10_a_job_fair_b.dialogue.6.textTr: Yes, I can collaborate well with designers and other developers. I use Git for version control every day.
podcast_a2_ep10_a_job_fair_b.dialogue.7.textTr: Excellent. Our internship starts in June and lasts for ten weeks. Do you have a copy of your resume with you?
podcast_a2_ep10_a_job_fair_b.dialogue.8.textTr: Yes, here is my printed CV and the QR code link to my GitHub repositories.
podcast_a2_ep10_a_job_fair_b.dialogue.9.textTr: Perfect, Kevin. We will review your application and send you an email by next Friday.
podcast_a2_ep10_a_job_fair_b.dialogue.10.textTr: Thank you so much for your time and consideration!
podcast_a2_ep10_a_job_fair_b.dialogue.11.textTr: Congratulations on completing the A2 series! Practice summarizing your skills using I have built... and I can code in...!

podcast_b1_ep01_the_job_inte.subtitle: Job Interview & Career Vision
podcast_b1_ep01_the_job_inte.description: Describe your 4 years of digital product and marketing experience, managing tight deadlines in crisis situations, data-driven problem solving, and leadership vision.
podcast_b1_ep01_the_job_inte.topicsCovered.0: Present Perfect Continuous (I have been working as...)
podcast_b1_ep01_the_job_inte.topicsCovered.1: Behavioral interview response patterns (When facing tight deadlines...)
podcast_b1_ep01_the_job_inte.dialogue.0.textTr: Welcome to B1 Intermediate Episode 1! Alex is interviewing for a senior marketing role at TechCorp with Victoria. Listen for professional business idioms and complex tenses.
podcast_b1_ep01_the_job_inte.dialogue.1.textTr: Welcome, Alex. Thank you for coming in today. To start off, could you walk me through your professional background?
podcast_b1_ep01_the_job_inte.dialogue.2.textTr: Thank you, Victoria. For the past four years, I have been working as a digital growth specialist at a fast-paced fintech startup. During this time, I have been managing cross-functional teams and optimizing our user acquisition funnels.
podcast_b1_ep01_the_job_inte.dialogue.3.textTr: That sounds comprehensive. How do you handle high-pressure situations when facing tight deadlines?
podcast_b1_ep01_the_job_inte.dialogue.4.textTr: When unexpected roadblocks occur, I always rely on a data-driven prioritization framework. For instance, last quarter our primary customer onboarding funnel broke right before a major campaign. I organized an emergency standup, identified the root cause with our engineers, and we resolved the issue within four hours, which prevented significant customer churn.
podcast_b1_ep01_the_job_inte.dialogue.5.textTr: Excellent example of adaptability. Where do you see yourself professionally in the next three to five years?
podcast_b1_ep01_the_job_inte.dialogue.6.textTr: I aim to transition into a strategic product leadership role where I can guide multidisciplinary teams and scale enterprise platforms internationally.
podcast_b1_ep01_the_job_inte.dialogue.7.textTr: That aligns perfectly with our company trajectory. Do you have any questions for us regarding team culture?
podcast_b1_ep01_the_job_inte.dialogue.8.textTr: Yes, could you tell me how your product and engineering departments collaborate during sprint planning?
podcast_b1_ep01_the_job_inte.dialogue.9.textTr: Notice Alex's use of the Present Perfect Continuous: I have been working as a growth specialist. A powerful structure for job interviews!

podcast_b1_ep02_apartment_hu.subtitle: Rental & Lease Negotiation
podcast_b1_ep02_apartment_hu.description: Tour the renovated two-bedroom corner apartment, $1800 rent and included expenses (heating, water), 12-month lease, 1-month deposit, and pet conditions.
podcast_b1_ep02_apartment_hu.topicsCovered.0: Real estate and lease law terms (lease agreement
podcast_b1_ep02_apartment_hu.dialogue.0.textTr: In Episode 2, Laura is inspecting a modern apartment in the city center with real estate agent Ryan. Listen to property terms and negotiation questions!
podcast_b1_ep02_apartment_hu.dialogue.1.textTr: Welcome to the Riverside Residences, Laura. This is the two-bedroom corner unit that you inquired about online.
podcast_b1_ep02_apartment_hu.dialogue.2.textTr: Wow, it is remarkably bright! Has the apartment been refurbished recently?
podcast_b1_ep02_apartment_hu.dialogue.3.textTr: Yes, the landlord had the entire kitchen renovated and installed double-glazed energy-efficient windows last month.
podcast_b1_ep02_apartment_hu.dialogue.4.textTr: The open-concept kitchen looks fantastic. What is the monthly rent, and what does it include?
podcast_b1_ep02_apartment_hu.dialogue.5.textTr: The rent is $1,800 per month. Water and central heating are included in the price, whereas electricity and high-speed fiber internet are billed separately.
podcast_b1_ep02_apartment_hu.dialogue.6.textTr: That is quite reasonable. What are the terms regarding the lease agreement and the security deposit?
podcast_b1_ep02_apartment_hu.dialogue.7.textTr: The landlord requires a standard twelve-month lease and a one-month security deposit upfront, which will be fully refunded when you move out, provided there is no property damage.
podcast_b1_ep02_apartment_hu.dialogue.8.textTr: Are pets allowed in the building? I have a small domestic cat.
podcast_b1_ep02_apartment_hu.dialogue.9.textTr: Yes, the building has a pet-friendly policy, but there is a small one-time pet sanitation fee of $100.
podcast_b1_ep02_apartment_hu.dialogue.10.textTr: That sounds fair. If I submit my application and employment verification today, how soon can I sign the contract?
podcast_b1_ep02_apartment_hu.dialogue.11.textTr: We can prepare the lease agreement by Thursday afternoon!
podcast_b1_ep02_apartment_hu.dialogue.12.textTr: Important vocabulary to remember: security deposit, lease agreement, and utilities included. Very practical for living abroad!

podcast_b1_ep03_delayed_flig.subtitle: Flight Delays & Lost Luggage Compensation
podcast_b1_ep03_delayed_flig.description: Report lost luggage for missed flight in Frankfurt, emergency expense allowance up to $150 (PIR report), and delivery to hotel promised.
podcast_b1_ep03_delayed_flig.dialogue.0.textTr: Welcome to Episode 3! Natalie's luggage did not arrive after a flight delay in Frankfurt. Listen to how she professionally files a lost baggage claim.
podcast_b1_ep03_delayed_flig.dialogue.1.textTr: Good evening, ma'am. How can I assist you at the baggage service counter?
podcast_b1_ep03_delayed_flig.dialogue.2.textTr: Good evening. My flight from Frankfurt was delayed by two hours, and I have been waiting at baggage carousel 4 for over forty minutes. My suitcase never appeared.
podcast_b1_ep03_delayed_flig.dialogue.3.textTr: I apologize for the inconvenience. May I see your baggage claim receipt and your boarding pass?
podcast_b1_ep03_delayed_flig.dialogue.4.textTr: Here they are. It is a large hard-shell navy blue Samsonite suitcase.
podcast_b1_ep03_delayed_flig.dialogue.5.textTr: Let me check our global tracking system... Yes, I see what happened. Due to the tight connection in Frankfurt, your bag was loaded onto the subsequent flight, which lands here tomorrow morning at 8 AM.
podcast_b1_ep03_delayed_flig.dialogue.6.textTr: Tomorrow morning? But all my business attire and personal toiletries are in that bag, and I have an executive conference tomorrow at noon!
podcast_b1_ep03_delayed_flig.dialogue.7.textTr: We completely understand your frustration. We will issue an official Property Irregularity Report (PIR). Under our airline policy, you are entitled to an emergency allowance of up to $150 to purchase essential clothing and toiletries. Keep all your receipts so we can reimburse you.
podcast_b1_ep03_delayed_flig.dialogue.8.textTr: How will my bag reach me once it lands?
podcast_b1_ep03_delayed_flig.dialogue.9.textTr: As soon as the flight arrives, your luggage will be dispatched directly to your hotel via express courier free of charge. Here is your tracking reference number.
podcast_b1_ep03_delayed_flig.dialogue.10.textTr: Thank you for resolving this so efficiently, Kevin.
podcast_b1_ep03_delayed_flig.dialogue.11.textTr: Notice the passive voice: Your bag was loaded onto the subsequent flight. Practice reporting customer service issues in English!

podcast_b1_ep04_smart_techno.subtitle: Smart Technologies in Daily Life
podcast_b1_ep04_smart_techno.description: Using productive AI and automation tools in daily workflows, notification clutter, data security, and screen time balance.
podcast_b1_ep04_smart_techno.topicsCovered.0: Second Conditional (If I didn't use automation
podcast_b1_ep04_smart_techno.dialogue.0.textTr: In Episode 4, Liam and Chloe discuss how smart productivity apps and AI tools have transformed their daily working routines.
podcast_b1_ep04_smart_techno.dialogue.1.textTr: Liam, I have noticed that you finish your daily coding and documentation tasks much faster recently. What is your secret?
podcast_b1_ep04_smart_techno.dialogue.2.textTr: Honestly, I have been using AI coding assistants and automation scripts for repetitive tasks. If I didn't automate my test generation, I would spend hours writing boilerplate code every single day.
podcast_b1_ep04_smart_techno.dialogue.3.textTr: That makes sense. But don't you worry about data privacy when feeding company code into cloud AI services?
podcast_b1_ep04_smart_techno.dialogue.4.textTr: That is a very valid concern. We configured enterprise privacy settings which ensure that none of our proprietary code is stored or used for model training.
podcast_b1_ep04_smart_techno.dialogue.5.textTr: What about all the smartphone notifications? I feel like I am constantly distracted by Slack and email alerts.
podcast_b1_ep04_smart_techno.dialogue.6.textTr: I used to feel the same way. Last month, I set up strict focus modes on my phone and turned off all non-essential notifications during deep work hours. It really helped me cut down on screen fatigue.
podcast_b1_ep04_smart_techno.dialogue.7.textTr: I should definitely try that. A productive workflow requires both smart tools and digital discipline!
podcast_b1_ep04_smart_techno.dialogue.8.textTr: Did you notice the second conditional: If I didn't automate my tests, I would spend hours? Great structure for discussing hypothetical situations!

podcast_b1_ep05_eco_friendly.subtitle: Eco-Friendly Living & Recycling
podcast_b1_ep05_eco_friendly.description: Reducing plastic waste, using solar panels on roofs, biking for transport, and composting organic household waste.
podcast_b1_ep05_eco_friendly.topicsCovered.0: Modals of obligation & advice (We should reduce
podcast_b1_ep05_eco_friendly.dialogue.0.textTr: Welcome to Episode 5! Ethan and Maya talk about simple, practical lifestyle changes to protect the environment in modern cities.
podcast_b1_ep05_eco_friendly.dialogue.1.textTr: Ethan, I noticed solar panels on your apartment rooftop yesterday. Did your building install them recently?
podcast_b1_ep05_eco_friendly.dialogue.2.textTr: Yes, we had them installed last spring. They generate almost 60% of our building's electricity, which significantly reduces our carbon footprint and electricity bills.
podcast_b1_ep05_eco_friendly.dialogue.3.textTr: That is wonderful! I have been trying to adopt a more sustainable lifestyle myself, but it can be challenging in a big city.
podcast_b1_ep05_eco_friendly.dialogue.4.textTr: Small everyday habits make a tremendous difference. For example, we should stop buying single-use plastic water bottles and carry reusable metal flasks instead.
podcast_b1_ep05_eco_friendly.dialogue.5.textTr: I already did that! I also started commuting to work by electric bicycle instead of driving my car.
podcast_b1_ep05_eco_friendly.dialogue.6.textTr: That is fantastic! Cycling not only reduces urban air pollution, but it is also much healthier. Have you ever tried composting kitchen food scraps?
podcast_b1_ep05_eco_friendly.dialogue.7.textTr: Not yet, but our municipality just placed organic waste collection bins in our neighborhood.
podcast_b1_ep05_eco_friendly.dialogue.8.textTr: That makes it so much easier. If everyone adopted just two eco-friendly habits, our cities would be much cleaner and greener!
podcast_b1_ep05_eco_friendly.dialogue.9.textTr: Notice the practical verbs: stop buying single-use plastic and started commuting by bicycle. What green habits do you practice?

podcast_b1_ep06_opening_a_ba.subtitle: Opening a Bank Account Abroad
podcast_b1_ep06_opening_a_ba.description: Opening an international student/worker account abroad, providing proof of address, setting up a contactless bank card and mobile banking.
podcast_b1_ep06_opening_a_ba.topicsCovered.2: Indirect question asking (Could you clarify if...)
podcast_b1_ep06_opening_a_ba.dialogue.0.textTr: In Episode 6, Daniel visits an international bank branch in Germany to open a local checking account. Listen to financial and banking terminology!
podcast_b1_ep06_opening_a_ba.dialogue.1.textTr: Good morning! Welcome to Horizon Bank. How can I assist you today, sir?
podcast_b1_ep06_opening_a_ba.dialogue.2.textTr: Good morning! I recently moved to Frankfurt for work, and I would like to open a local checking account for my salary and daily expenses.
podcast_b1_ep06_opening_a_ba.dialogue.3.textTr: Excellent. Are you employed locally, or are you a full-time university student?
podcast_b1_ep06_opening_a_ba.dialogue.4.textTr: I am a software engineer working on an international technology visa. Here is my employment contract, passport, and official proof of address.
podcast_b1_ep06_opening_a_ba.dialogue.5.textTr: Perfect. All documents are verified through our digital identity compliance system. We offer our Standard Digital Account, which has no monthly maintenance fee provided that you receive a regular direct deposit salary.
podcast_b1_ep06_opening_a_ba.dialogue.6.textTr: That sounds ideal. Does the account come with a contactless debit card and mobile banking access?
podcast_b1_ep06_opening_a_ba.dialogue.7.textTr: Yes, your digital debit card will be activated on your smartphone immediately, and your physical card will be delivered to your registered residential address within five business days.
podcast_b1_ep06_opening_a_ba.dialogue.8.textTr: Could you please clarify if there are any fees for international wire transfers?

podcast_b2_ep07_workplace_bu.dialogue.5.textTr: We recently introduced a company-wide policy of 'No-Meeting Wednesdays' and encouraged asynchronous documentation over reactive messaging.
podcast_b2_ep07_workplace_bu.dialogue.6.textTr: That is an exceptional structural intervention. By fostering an asynchronous environment, you empower your engineers to enter uninterrupted deep work states, thereby enhancing both output quality and psychological well-being.
podcast_b2_ep07_workplace_bu.dialogue.7.textTr: In the final analysis, employee retention and sustainable productivity are inseparable.

podcast_b2_ep10_cybersecurit.dialogue.0.textTr: In our final B2 episode, cyber law attorney Marcus and Data Protection Officer Helena debate regulatory enforcement, digital sovereignty, and the future of consumer privacy.
podcast_b2_ep10_cybersecurit.dialogue.1.textTr: Marcus, as machine learning models ingest colossal volumes of personal user data, how are international privacy frameworks adapting to prevent mass surveillance?
podcast_b2_ep10_cybersecurit.dialogue.2.textTr: The regulatory landscape is undergoing aggressive transformation, Helena. The stringent enforcement of data sovereignty frameworks such as GDPR and CCPA mandates that personal telemetry be anonymized and processed strictly under explicit consent.
podcast_b2_ep10_cybersecurit.dialogue.3.textTr: It was the unregulated monetization of personal behavioral data that gave rise to modern surveillance capitalism.
podcast_b2_ep10_cybersecurit.dialogue.4.textTr: Exactly. Not only do current regulations impose multi-million-dollar fines on non-compliant corporations, but they also empower individuals with the absolute 'right to be forgotten'.
podcast_b2_ep10_cybersecurit.dialogue.5.textTr: In our engineering department, privacy is no longer an afterthought; it is integrated directly into our architectural blueprints via privacy-by-design principles.
podcast_b2_ep10_cybersecurit.dialogue.6.textTr: Should corporations fail to uphold these fundamental digital rights, consumer trust will evaporate irreversibly.
podcast_b2_ep10_cybersecurit.dialogue.7.textTr: Suffice it to say, strong cryptographic encryption and transparent data governance are completely non-negotiable in the twenty-first century.
podcast_b2_ep10_cybersecurit.dialogue.8.textTr: Congratulations on completing the entire B2 Upper-Intermediate series! You now have a complete, professional, and intellectually rich English listening foundation!
